meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的改动整理成极简的 git 提交消息：采用 Conventional Commits 格式，主题行精简（≤50 字符），只在改动原因不明显时补正文。它只生成消息，不执行 git 命令，输出为可粘贴的代码块。
howto.when: 当你说出“write a commit”“commit message”“generate commit”“/commit”等，或暂存区有改动时自动触发。

say.note: 按暂存改动生成提交消息。

say.text: 为暂存的改动生成 commit 信息
say.note: 自动提取改动并套用格式。

say.text: 主题控制在 50 字符内
say.note: 提交消息会优先精简主题行。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns your changes into a terse git commit message: Conventional Commits format, subject kept compact (≤50 chars), body only when the reason isn't obvious. It only generates the message, never runs git, and outputs a ready-to-paste code block.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or when changes are staged.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for me
say_en.note: Generates a commit message from staged changes.

say_en.text: Generate a commit message for the staged changes
say_en.note: Extracts changes and applies the format.
